name: Turkey-Egg Fried Rice with Carrots, Peas & Scallions (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup jasmine rice
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the carrot. (Set a small handful of onions aside for serving.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl, along with frozen peas, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 clove garlic
¾ cup frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
1 lb ground turkey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a small bowl and whisk to combine. Set aside.
When the turkey is done, add veggies, ginger, and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add egg to the skillet and stir-fry until cooked through and combined, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
When the rice is done, add to the skillet, along with soy sauce, and stir to combine.

Divide fried rice between storage containers, top with reserved green onion, and set aside to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat in a skillet, the oven, or a microwave and enjoy!
